test_ensemble_heterogeneous_estimators_b: test the ensemble heterogeneous estimators behavior for stacking and voting classifiers and regressors
test_ensemble_heterogeneous_estimators_t: test that ensemble estimators fail validation when underlying estimators mismatch classifier or regressor type
test_ensemble_heterogeneous_estimators_n: test that ensemble estimator names must not contain dunder underscores, must be unique, and must not conflict with constructor arguments
test_ensemble_heterogeneous_estimators_a: test that a ValueError is raised when all estimators in an ensemble are dropped
test_heterogeneous_ensemble_support_miss: test that voting and stacking ensembles delegate missing values validation to underlying estimators via pipelines
